title: Tasks page v1
description: Body of GET /api/tasks: one keyset page of task-item, newest updatedAtMs first with taskId descending as the tie-break, at most 25 per page. Optional query filters are state and bindingId. nextCursor is an opaque cursor for the next page, or null on the last page. asOfMs is the server time the page was read and is the clock for every runMs and sizeClass in it. GET /api/tasks/{taskId} returns one bare task-item.
